witnesses.name: fall local-clock boundary
witnesses.source_reason: Timezone offset subtraction removes 60 local-clock minutes: 180 -> 120.

witnesses.name: leap-day full year at February end
witnesses.source_reason: mNr normalizes February 28 to March 2 before subtracting 12 months; full months=12. Current day-only comparison subtracts one: months=11.

witnesses.name: year boundary before full month clock time
witnesses.source_reason: mNr compares the full date after subtracting 12 months: 12:00 is before 13:00, so full months=11. Current compares dates only and retains 12.

witnesses.name: ordinary same-offset hours control
witnesses.source_reason: Same offset, so elapsed minutes equal normalized minutes.

witnesses.name: complete ordinary year control
witnesses.source_reason: Complete 12 months under both source branches.
